about: Yalavarti Infra Projects builds houses, apartments and townships, and the civil infrastructure around them: roads, drainage, water supply and sewerage.
We take a project from the land and its approvals through design and construction to handover.
Work is inspected against the drawings and the specification before it is covered up or poured.

steps.d: We check the plot, its title papers and the rules that apply, and take the plans through building permission.
Architectural and structural drawings, the specification and a costed bill of quantities you can check line by line.
Soil checked, the site set out, excavation and footings cast to the drawings.
Columns, beams and slabs, floor by floor, to the structural drawings.
Masonry, plastering, flooring, doors, windows and paint, to the specification you agreed.
A walk-through with you, any snags put right, and the keys.

safety.title: Health, safety & environment
safety.text: Our sites work to a written safety plan, and every incident and near miss is recorded and investigated.

safety.title: Quality
safety.text: Work is inspected against the drawings and the specification before it is covered up or poured. Anything that does not pass is recorded and put right.

safety.title: Materials
safety.text: Cement, steel, aggregates and concrete are checked when they arrive and tested as the work goes on. The records are kept with the project.
